# AI Image Recognition for Todos - Requirements Specification

## Overview

This specification defines the requirements for adding AI-powered image recognition functionality to the ImageTodo application. Users will be able to paste screenshots (already in clipboard from the existing screenshot feature) into todos, have the image content automatically recognized and summarized by AI, and view the original image when clicking the todo.

## Business Context

### Problem Statement
Currently, ImageTodo users can capture screenshots to clipboard, but there's no way to:
1. Attach these screenshots to todos
2. Automatically extract meaningful information from screenshots
3. Convert visual information into actionable text todos
4. Reference the original screenshot later

### Solution Vision
Transform ImageTodo into an intelligent visual task manager where users can:
- Paste screenshots directly into the todo input
- Have AI automatically analyze and summarize the image content
- Create text-based todos from visual information
- View original images by clicking on image-based todos

### Success Criteria
- Users can paste images from clipboard into todo input
- AI successfully extracts and summarizes image content with >90% accuracy
- Todo creation from images takes <5 seconds
- Image viewing is instant and intuitive
- Feature works offline with graceful degradation

## Functional Requirements

### FR-001: Image Paste Detection
**As a** ImageTodo user  
**I want to** paste images from clipboard into the todo input field  
**So that** I can quickly create todos from screenshots

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** user pastes (Ctrl/Cmd+V) in the todo input field
- **And** clipboard contains an image
- **Then** the application detects the image paste event
- **And** displays a loading indicator
- **And** prevents normal text paste behavior

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: User presses Ctrl/Cmd+V in todo input
- **Action**: Check clipboard for image data
- **Response**: Trigger image processing workflow if image detected
- **State**: Todo input is focused

**Technical Notes:**
- Use browser's `paste` event listener
- Check `event.clipboardData.items` for image types
- Support common formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP
- File size limit: 10MB

---

### FR-002: Image Storage
**As a** ImageTodo user  
**I want** pasted images to be saved locally  
**So that** I can view them later even offline

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** an image is pasted
- **Then** the image is saved to local storage
- **And** a unique identifier is generated
- **And** the file path is stored with the todo
- **And** images are stored in a dedicated folder
- **And** old images are cleaned up when todos are deleted

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: Image paste detected
- **Action**: Save image to local filesystem
- **Response**: Return file path and unique ID
- **State**: Image data available in clipboard

**Technical Notes:**
- Save to: `{app_data}/images/{todo_id}_{timestamp}.png`
- Use Tauri's filesystem API
- Generate UUID for todo_id
- Implement cleanup on todo deletion

---

### FR-003: AI Image Recognition
**As a** ImageTodo user  
**I want** the AI to analyze pasted images  
**So that** I get an accurate text summary of the image content

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** an image is pasted and saved
- **Then** the image is sent to AI service for analysis
- **And** AI extracts text content (OCR)
- **And** AI generates a concise summary (1-2 sentences)
- **And** the summary is displayed as the todo text
- **And** processing completes within 5 seconds
- **And** errors are handled gracefully with fallback

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: Image saved successfully
- **Action**: Send image to AI API for recognition
- **Response**: Receive text summary and create todo
- **State**: Image file exists locally

**Technical Notes:**
- Primary: OpenAI GPT-4.1 Vision API
- Fallback: Local OCR (Tesseract) + simple summarization
- API timeout: 10 seconds
- Retry logic: 2 attempts
- Error handling: Allow manual text entry if AI fails

---

### FR-004: OCR and AI Separation (Optional)
**As a** power user  
**I want** to choose between OCR-only or full AI analysis  
**So that** I can control cost and processing time

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** user pastes an image
- **Then** user can optionally choose processing mode
- **And** "OCR Only" mode extracts text without summarization
- **And** "AI Summary" mode provides intelligent summary
- **And** default mode is configurable in settings

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: Image paste detected
- **Action**: Show processing mode selector (optional)
- **Response**: Process image according to selected mode
- **State**: Image ready for processing

**Technical Notes:**
- Setting: `imageProcessingMode: 'ocr' | 'ai' | 'auto'`
- OCR: Use Tesseract.js or Rust OCR library
- AI: Use vision API
- Auto: Use OCR for text-heavy images, AI for others

---

### FR-005: Todo Data Model Extension
**As a** developer  
**I want** the Todo data model to support image attachments  
**So that** image-based todos can be properly stored and retrieved

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** a todo is created from an image
- **Then** the todo includes image metadata
- **And** the original text is preserved
- **And** the image path is stored
- **And** the processing method is recorded
- **And** all data persists across app restarts

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: Todo creation with image
- **Action**: Extend todo object with image fields
- **Response**: Save extended todo to store
- **State**: Image processed and saved

**Technical Notes:**
```typescript
interface Todo {
  id: string
  text: string
  completed: boolean
  createdAt: number
  // New fields:
  hasImage?: boolean
  imagePath?: string
  imageProcessingMethod?: 'ocr' | 'ai'
  originalImageText?: string  // Raw OCR output
}
```

---

### FR-006: Image Viewing Popup
**As a** ImageTodo user  
**I want** to click on image-based todos to view the original image  
**So that** I can see the visual context of the task

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** user clicks on a todo with an image
- **Then** a popup/modal displays the original image
- **And** the image is shown at full resolution
- **And** the popup can be closed with ESC or click outside
- **And** the popup shows both image and extracted text
- **And** the popup is responsive and works on all screen sizes

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: User clicks on image-based todo
- **Action**: Load and display image in modal
- **Response**: Show image with metadata
- **State**: Todo has associated image

**Technical Notes:**
- Use existing Radix UI Dialog component
- Load image from local path
- Show: image, extracted text, processing method
- Support zoom/pan for large images
- Lazy load images for performance

---

### FR-007: Visual Indicators
**As a** ImageTodo user  
**I want** to see which todos have images attached  
**So that** I can quickly identify image-based tasks

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- **When** viewing the todo list
- **Then** todos with images show a visual indicator (icon)
- **And** the indicator is clearly visible
- **And** the indicator is consistent with app design
- **And** hovering shows a preview tooltip (optional)

**EARS Format:**
- **Event**: Todo list rendered
- **Action**: Check each todo for image attachment
- **Response**: Display image icon for image-based todos
- **State**: Todo list displayed

**Technical Notes:**
- Use lucide-react icon: `Image` or `FileImage`
- Position: Next to todo text
- Color: Accent color
- Tooltip: Show thumbnail on hover (future enhancement)

---

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-001: Performance
- Image paste detection: <100ms
- Image save to disk: <500ms
- AI processing: <5 seconds (target: 3 seconds)
- Image popup load: <200ms
- App remains responsive during processing

### NFR-002: Reliability
- AI API availability: 99% uptime
- Fallback to local OCR if API fails
- Graceful degradation: Allow manual text entry
- No data loss on processing failure
- Automatic retry on network errors

### NFR-003: Security
- API keys stored securely (environment variables or secure storage)
- Images stored locally, not uploaded unless necessary
- User consent for cloud processing
- No sensitive data logged
- Secure API communication (HTTPS)

### NFR-004: Usability
- Clear loading states during processing
- Informative error messages
- Undo capability for AI-generated text
- Manual text editing always available
- Consistent with existing UI/UX patterns

### NFR-005: Internationalization
- All UI text supports Chinese and English
- Error messages localized
- AI summaries in user's preferred language
- OCR supports multiple languages

### NFR-006: Scalability
- Support up to 1000 image-based todos
- Efficient image storage (compression)
- Cleanup of orphaned images
- Pagination for image-heavy lists

---

## Technical Constraints

### TC-001: Technology Stack
- Must use existing Tauri + React + TypeScript stack
- Must integrate with existing arboard clipboard handling
- Must use existing Radix UI components
- Must follow existing code patterns and conventions

### TC-002: Platform Support
- Must work on Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Clipboard image paste must work on all platforms
- File system operations must be cross-platform

### TC-003: Dependencies
- Minimize new dependencies
- Prefer Rust-based solutions for backend
- Use well-maintained libraries only
- Consider bundle size impact

### TC-004: API Integration
- Support multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Claude, etc.)
- API keys configurable by user
- Rate limiting and cost control
- Offline mode with local OCR

---

## User Stories Summary

1. **Quick Image Todo Creation**: Paste screenshot → AI analyzes → Todo created
2. **Visual Reference**: Click todo → View original image
3. **Offline Capability**: Use local OCR when internet unavailable
4. **Cost Control**: Choose between OCR-only and full AI analysis
5. **Data Privacy**: Images stored locally, cloud processing optional

---

## Out of Scope

The following are explicitly **not** included in this specification:

- Image editing capabilities
- Multiple images per todo
- Image search/filtering
- Cloud sync of images
- Image compression settings UI
- Batch image processing
- Image annotations
- Screenshot capture improvements (already implemented)
- Video or GIF support

---

## Dependencies

### Internal Dependencies
- Existing screenshot functionality (provides images to clipboard)
- Existing todo data model and storage
- Existing UI components (Dialog, Button, Input)
- Existing i18n system

### External Dependencies
- AI Vision API (OpenAI GPT-4.1 or Claude 3.5)
- OCR library (Tesseract or Rust equivalent)
- Tauri filesystem API
- Tauri clipboard plugin or arboard enhancement

---

## Risks and Mitigations

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| AI API costs too high | High | Medium | Implement local OCR fallback, add usage limits |
| AI processing too slow | Medium | Low | Set timeout, show progress, allow cancellation |
| Clipboard API limitations | High | Medium | Test on all platforms, provide file upload alternative |
| Image storage fills disk | Medium | Medium | Implement cleanup, compression, size limits |
| OCR accuracy poor | Medium | Medium | Use high-quality AI API, allow manual editing |

---

## Acceptance Testing

### Test Scenario 1: Happy Path
1. User takes screenshot (Alt+Shift+P)
2. User focuses todo input and pastes (Ctrl+V)
3. Loading indicator appears
4. Within 5 seconds, todo is created with AI summary
5. Todo shows image indicator icon
6. User clicks todo, image popup appears
7. User can see original screenshot and extracted text

### Test Scenario 2: Offline Mode
1. User disconnects from internet
2. User pastes image
3. Local OCR processes image
4. Todo created with OCR text (no AI summary)
5. User notified of offline mode

### Test Scenario 3: Error Handling
1. User pastes image
2. AI API fails
3. System retries once
4. Falls back to local OCR
5. User can manually edit text
6. Error message shown but todo still created

---

## Glossary

- **OCR**: Optical Character Recognition - extracting text from images
- **AI Vision**: AI models that can understand and describe image content
- **Image-based Todo**: A todo created from a pasted image with AI-generated text
- **Processing Mode**: The method used to analyze images (OCR-only vs full AI)
- **Fallback**: Alternative processing method when primary method fails

---

## Approval

This requirements document must be approved before proceeding to design phase.
